cards.text: Next, Jesus and His disciples come to Jericho, and now they're heading out of town with a large crowd. Sitting beside the road is a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus. He can't see a thing, but he can hear the whole crowd coming his way.

cards.question: Bartimaeus hears that it's Jesus of Nazareth passing by. He can't see Him. What does he do?

answers.text: He starts crying out to Jesus
He sends someone to bring Jesus
He waits for the crowd to pass

cards.text: He shouts, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!” No hello. No small talk. Straight to the POINT.

cards.question: A blind beggar is shouting beside the road as a big crowd goes by. Many of the people tell Bartimaeus to be ___.
When many people tell Bartimaeus to be silent, he quiets down and waits.

cards.text: He cries out all the LOUDER: “Son of David, have mercy on me!” They told this man to hush, and he heard TURN IT UP.

cards.question: Jesus is leaving Jericho with a large crowd, and one voice keeps shouting for mercy. What does Jesus do?

answers.text: He stops and has him called over
He keeps walking and waves to him
He sends a disciple to bless him

cards.question: Jesus says, “Call him,” so the people call the blind man. What do they tell Bartimaeus?

answers.text: Take courage because Jesus is calling him
Ask quickly because Jesus is in a hurry
Speak softly because Jesus is teaching

cards.question: When Bartimaeus hears that Jesus is calling for him, he jumps up and comes to Jesus.

cards.text: And he throws off his cloak while he's at it. Friend, I have hit SNOOZE on days I was excited about, and this man is out of his cloak before anybody finishes saying “Get up!”

Jesus asks him, “What do you want Me to do for you?” That's the exact question He just asked James and John, two of His disciples, and they asked to sit at His right and left in His glory (Mark 10:36-37).

cards.question: Bartimaeus calls Jesus “Rabboni” and asks Him to let him ___ again.

cards.text: No seats, no glory, just his eyes. “Go,” Jesus tells him, “your faith has healed you.”

cards.question: After Jesus tells him his faith has healed him, Bartimaeus has to wait a while for his sight to come back.
Bartimaeus can see, and Jesus just told him “Go.” Where does he go?

answers.text: He follows Jesus along the road

cards.text: He started out sitting BESIDE the road, begging. Now he's ON the road, right behind Jesus.

findings.problem: This card only recaps Bartimaeus sitting beside the road in verse 46 and following Jesus in verse 52, which the walkthrough has already covered. It does not move the passage forward.

rule.text:
Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.
- No recap cards.
